  |{{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}} defines [[the Slice]] as the area of [[Realspace|space]] between the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run]], and ''[[The Living Force]]'' establishes the edge of the [[Core Worlds]] as the coreward border of the Slice. {{GalaxyMapAppendix}} places {{{1|}}} in grid square {{{grid|}}}, which the [[Star Wars Galaxy Map|''Star Wars'' Galaxy Map]] shows falls within the Slice as defined previously.
  |{{{2|}}} places {{{1|}}} in the area of [[realspace|space]] between the [[Perlemian Trade Route]] and the [[Corellian Run]], which are the borders of [[the Slice]] as defined by {{EncyclopediaCite|Scarif and Other Planets in the Outer Rim}}, and outside of the [[Core Worlds]], which is the coreward edge of the Slice per ''[[The Living Force]]''.
